features.name: Stacking bonus
features.description: All three active puts 10x on reel three.

review:
Bats, dragons and tigers. Money symbols worth 2x to 500x land on reels 1 to 4 and get collected by symbols on reel five.

Each animal scatter can trigger six free spins with its own reel multipliers – bats on reels one and two, dragons on two to four, tigers on four and five – and if all three are active, reel three gets 10x. Scatters in the bonus add three spins, and multipliers stack. Up to 5,000x, 96.02% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
